_comment: Site-wide settings. Edit here, then run `node build.mjs`. See README.md.

pages._comment: Each page is rendered once per language. slug = the URL segment after the language folder (empty = language home).

form._comment: N8N: paste the Webhook node's PRODUCTION URL into endpoint (it looks like https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/<path>), then run `node build.mjs`. adapter: json (n8n default) | formdata | hubspot. Never put credentials or API keys here: this value is visible in the public page source.

organization._comment: Only confirmed facts. Used for JSON-LD structured data. Empty values are left out: add telephone / sameAs (e.g. a LinkedIn URL) only when they exist.
organization.name: Ladea Technologies
